t: The Ministry of Statistics released all-India CPI (base 2024=100) data for September 2026: provisional year-on-year retail inflation of 5.54% (combined), 6.08% rural and 4.88% urban; food inflation 7.74%.
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh released the Indian Army's Land Warfare Doctrine 2026 at the Army Commanders' Conference in New Delhi, placing AI and drones at the centre of future warfare.
Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit was appointed the 29th Chief of the Air Staff, succeeding Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh with effect from the afternoon of 31 October 2026.
Daniil Medvedev defended his Almaty Open title, beating qualifier Nikoloz Basilashvili 6-7(6), 6-1, 6-3 for his 25th tour-level title.
Lorenzo Musetti won the ATP 250 Grand Prix Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes in Lyon, beating second seed Taylor Fritz 6-3, 6-4 for his first tour-level title since 2022.
